semantics.order_rule: Recovery-relevant ordering or sequence identity is explicit.
semantics.durability_rule: Durability point/profile is explicit where recovery semantics depend on it.
semantics.implementation_rule: Physical WAL/log format is implementation-specific unless separately standardized.
semantics.audit_rule: Audit evidence is immutable append/history governed.
semantics.replay_rule: Replay re-applies only committed/eligible evidence according to explicit recovery policy.
semantics.authority_rule: Audit/WAL evidence is not an alternate mutation API.

invariants.rule: Physical storage location, file name, engine page, snapshot artifact or backup copy never replaces canonical data/schema/instance identity; persistence and recovery operate on exact semantic identities with explicit version/provenance evidence.
